extension.description: Pixel art preview with automatic zoom fitted to the window.
command.open.title: Open Preview
command.toggle.title: Toggle Auto Zoom
config.enabled.description: Automatically open supported images in Pixel Zoom. Disable to use the built-in image preview.
config.maxPixelArtSize.description: Maximum size (in pixels, longest side) below which an image is treated as pixel art and zoomed automatically.
config.defaultSmoothing.description: Enable smoothing by default (disabled = sharp, pixelated rendering).
config.checkerboard.description: Show a checkerboard behind images to reveal transparency.
